documents.title: Operation Juno Investigation Report: Concerning certain conduct of Mr Walter Sofronoff KC.

cite.document: Operation Juno Investigation Report: Concerning certain conduct of Mr Walter Sofronoff KC.

findings.label: serious corrupt conduct
findings.text: The Commission has concluded that certain aspects of Mr Sofronoff’s conduct as Board of an Inquiry instituted under the Inquiries Act 1991 amounted to serious corrupt conduct as defined in the Integrity Commission Act 2018.

cite.document: Operation Juno Investigation Report: Concerning certain conduct of Mr Walter Sofronoff KC.

notes: Date is the date of the Commission's letter or statement giving the report to the Speaker of the ACT Legislative Assembly (report page 4).

The Commission accepts that s 36 of the Inquiries Act is not capable of applying to a single member Board of Inquiry. In Federal Court proceedings NSD389/2025 commenced by Mr Sofronoff in relation to the Operation Juno report, the Commission did not seek to defend its finding that Mr Sofronoff engaged in conduct that could constitute an offence contrary to s 36 of the Inquiries Act 1991.
No numbered recommendations of the Commission's own were found in the report text. Numbered recommendations quoted in the report from other bodies are not recorded.
